facts.fact: The proposed OGE 2026 sets Kz 32.3bn (about USD 35m) for the programme to improve Angola's Global Cybersecurity Index position, within the Kz 159.2bn communications programme; proposal stage, not yet enacted.

facts.fact: The cybersecurity programme is cut 54%, from Kz 70.5bn in the 2025 budget to Kz 32.3bn in the proposed 2026 budget.
